title: SREV-328 SXS RpcSs alt CreateActCtx topology
stage: data -> schema -> topology -> logic -> action -> verify
contracts: CreateActCtxW owns the final activation-context handle
Sandboxie owns only the optional SXS service projection and boxed-path translation around ACTCTXW
SandboxieRpcSs must not synchronously re-enter the in-sandbox RPCSS_SXS service it implements
Sxs_UseAltCreateActCtx routes to native CreateActCtxW when the service route is unsafe or unavailable
the *UseAltCreateActCtx* sentinel is a local topology gate, not an official Microsoft SXS API
SREV-328 changes comments and proof only, not SXS routing behavior
runtime_gate: Capture SandboxieRpcSs startup and SXS activation-context creation to prove the service process uses the alternate path without blocking on its own RPCSS_SXS queue, while normal sandboxed callers still use the queue path when available
